'''Tommet Sozach''' was a [[Ginmid]] who led an [[Ginmid mercenary army|army]] of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] to make a living. When predictions of prolonged peace in [[the galaxy]] proved true, Sozach left the [[army]] to operate on his own and began working as a trick shooter until a [[Death|fatal]] accident during a demonstration resulted in him being issued a death sentence.

On the run, Sozach settled on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]] as a self-defense instructor. In [[35 ABY]], he spent [[time]] in the bar of the [[Spice Runners' Den]] in [[Kijimi City]] shortly before the [[Sith Eternal]] [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] Kijimi.

==Biography==
Tommet Sozach was a [[Ginmid]] who made a living working as the leader of a [[Ginmid mercenary army|mercenary army]] made up exclusively of members of his own [[species]]. After he had commanded the [[army]] for some time, the [[mercenary]] group broke up when the prospect of a lasting peace in [[the galaxy]] arose,<ref name="Djarin" /> with Sozach choosing to break out on his own when the predictions of prolonged peace proved accurate.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Trying to make a living through other means,<ref name="Djarin" /> Sozach succeeded as a crowd-pleasing trick shooter<ref name="TROS VD" /> in a marksmanship show that he put on until<ref name="Djarin" /> a demonstration went wrong<ref name="TROS VD" /> and resulted in a [[Death|fatal]] accident.<ref name="Djarin" />

[[File:Tommet_Sozach_and_Companion.png|thumb|right|200px|Tommet spent time with a human in the Spice Runners' Den.]]
The incident resulted in a death sentence for Sozach<ref name="TROS VD" /> and a price on his head as he went on the run. Settling on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]], he began working as a self-defense instructor. By the [[time]] of the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]], most of the [[soldier]]s who had previously served in Sozach's army had already retired.<ref name="Djarin" /> During the First Order's [[occupation of Kijimi]]<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> the defense instructor spent time in the bar of the [[Spice Runners' Den]] in [[Kijimi City]] and was stood with a [[human]] by the entrance when the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi|Spice Runner]] [[Zorii Bliss]] led a group of Resistance agents into the room. Shortly after Sozach encountered the Resistance members,<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> the First Order [[Protocol 13|evacuated]] its [[First Order military|forces]] from Kijimi<ref name="TROS VD" /> prior to the world's [[Destruction of Kijimi|destruction]] by the [[Sith Eternal]].<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
When war returned to the galaxy after the prolonged period of peace, Sozach sometimes had to fight pangs of remorse for giving up his mercenary force despite the fact that most of his best soldiers had likely retired. He had [[Color|green]] skin.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
[[File:SpiceRunnerBlasterRifle-TROSVD.png|thumb|left|300px|Tommet Sozach's spice runner blaster rifle]]
Sozach wore a brown [[jacket]] made from cloned [[karabbac]]-pelt with a brown [[Hair|fur]] [[hat]] and a pair of orange [[goggles]]. His outfit also included a brown [[belt]], brown pants, and brown [[boot]]s. He carried a [[Spicerunner|spice runner]] [[blaster rifle]] with a widened bore on the [[barrel]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I think the production name for this guy was The Russian, and I think Jake originally concepted him with a big fur hat. I always tried to present alternate options when possible, so the padded version was taking the John Mollo quilting to the extreme.|Calum Alexander Watt|<ref name="TheRussian">{{Twitter|CalumAWatt|status/1273557865568010243|[[Calum Alexander Watt]]|date=2020-06-18|quote=I think the production name for this guy was The Russian, and I think Jake originally concepted him with a big fur hat. I always tried to present alternate options when possible, so the padded version was taking the John Mollo quilting to the extreme.|archivedate=20200618101613}}</ref>}}
[[File:Wizard_14_Version_1A.png|thumb|right|300px|Wizard 14 Version 1A - concept art of Sozach]]
Tommet Sozach was portrayed by [[Phill Woodfine]]<ref name="Woodfine">{{Twitter|username=JakeLuntDavies|url=status/1867512838560047458|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2024-12-13|quote=Tommet Sozach pg136 TROS visual guide. Designed by me. Performed by Phil Woodfine|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/cEmYD|archivefile=File:JakeLuntDavies-SozachActor-Twitter.png}} {{C|In response to: Interesting, I was re-watching the TROS BTS segment "Cast of Creatures," and noticed this individual in the background having what appears to be gray face paint and some wrinkled prosthetics being applied. Can't say I recall seeing this species in anything else?}}</ref> in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was identified simultaneously in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]],<ref name="TROS VD" /> and on a card in the [[2019 Topps Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Series 1]] trading card set by [[Topps|The Topps Company, Inc.]]<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2019 Topps Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Series 1|cardname=Tommet Sozach|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/211130/cid/13996009/2019-Topps-Star-Wars:-The-Rise-of-Skywalker-28-Tommet-Sozach}}</ref>

The creature design for Sozach was done by [[Jake Lunt Davies]],<ref name="LuntDavies">{{Twitter|CalumAWatt|status/1273556243261657088|[[Calum Alexander Watt]]|date=2020-06-18|quote=From The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker by@PhilSzostak. Costume concept art for Kijimi crowd, Tommet Sozach 2018. Creature design by Jake Lunt Davies. Alternate options for the same creature.|archivedate=20230224135005}}</ref> and the concept art of Sozach titled "Wizard 14 Version 1A" was created for the film by costume concept artist [[Calum Alexander Watt]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> Watt remembers the character's production name as "The Russian," with Lunt's original idea included the large fur hat, but in order to provide an alternate look, Watt created a second padded costume design based on the quilting designs of [[John Mollo]].<ref name="TheRussian" />

Concept art of the streets of Kijimi City produced by senior concept artist [[Tony Tran]] for the [[2024]] [[Massive Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' included Sozach with other characters<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=tonytran|url=artwork/RKKZBm|name=[[Tony Tran]]|text=''Star Wars Outlaws'' - Kijimi City Streets|date=2024-10-11}}</ref> that appeared on Kijimi in Episode IX.<ref name="TROS" /> None of these characters were used in the final release of the game.<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>
